changeSet.author: template
changeSet.comment: Registros de log de interfaces para desarrollo local (755 registros simulados)
changeSet.sql:
INSERT INTO interface_log (id, timestamp, operation_type, interface_name, request_payload, response_payload, status) SELECT s.id, TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE '2025-01-01 00:00:00+01:00' + (s.id * INTERVAL '35 minutes'), (ARRAY['GET', 'POST', 'PUT', 'DELETE', 'PATCH'])[1 + (s.id % 5)], (ARRAY[ 'api/users', 'api/reports', 'api/parameters', 'api/profiles', 'api/audit', 'api/interfaces', 'api/cluster/nodes', 'api/cluster/jobs', 'api/auth/login', 'api/auth/refresh', 'api/exports/csv', 'api/exports/pdf', 'api/notifications', 'api/health', 'api/metrics' ])[1 + (s.id % 15)], CASE WHEN s.id % 5 = 0 THEN '{"params":{"page":' || (s.id % 10) || ',"size":20}}' WHEN s.id % 5 = 1 THEN '{"body":{"name":"Registro ' || s.id || '","active":true}}' WHEN s.id % 5 = 2 THEN '{"body":{"id":' || (s.id % 100) || ',"description":"Actualización ' || s.id || '"}}' WHEN s.id % 5 = 3 THEN '{"params":{"id":' || (s.id % 100) || '}}' ELSE '{"body":{"field":"value_' || s.id || '","timestamp":"2025-01-' || LPAD(CAST(1 + (s.id % 28) AS TEXT), 2, '0') || '"}}' END, CASE WHEN s.id % 7 = 6 THEN '{"error":"Internal Server Error","code":500,"message":"Timeout de conexión con servicio externo"}' WHEN s.id % 7 = 5 THEN '{"error":"Not Found","code":404,"message":"Recurso no encontrado: id=' || (s.id % 100) || '"}' WHEN s.id % 7 = 4 THEN '{"error":"Bad Request","code":400,"message":"Validación fallida: campo obligatorio"}' ELSE '{"data":{"id":' || s.id || ',"success":true,"records":' || (s.id % 50) || '}}' END, CASE WHEN s.id % 7 = 6 THEN 'ERROR' WHEN s.id % 7 = 5 THEN 'NOT_FOUND' WHEN s.id % 7 = 4 THEN 'BAD_REQUEST' ELSE 'SUCCESS' END FROM generate_series(1, 755) AS s(id);
-- Actualizar la secuencia para evitar conflictos con futuros inserts SELECT setval('interface_log_seq', 800);

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM interface_log WHERE id BETWEEN 1 AND 755;
